annotations.title: Calculate the yearly IMI from the taxable value

description: Calculates the yearly IMI on an urban property (prédio urbano) from its taxable value (VPT) and the urban rate of its municipality. Use it for the yearly amount; for the rate alone use `imi_rate`, and for the one-off purchase taxes `imt_calculate`. The VPT is the Tax Authority's valuation on the caderneta predial, not the purchase price: ask the user for it rather than using the price. Only the urban rate is applied; rural property, AIMI and surcharges on vacant homes are not calculated. A municipality whose rate is set per parish is refused (rate_by_freguesia).

municipality.description: Municipality name (Porto, Lisboa or Lisbon, Vila Nova de Gaia) or its four-digit code (1312)

vpt.description: Valor Patrimonial Tributário — the taxable value of the property in euros, from the caderneta predial. Not the purchase price

name: imi_annual_cost

anyOf.description: Refusal rate_by_freguesia: the municipality's rate row, no yearly sum.
Refusal (isError: true). `error` is a machine code (not_found, bad_*, tool_failed…), `message` says what to fix.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.
